pacing.seams_on_onsets: 4 of 10 seams within 60 ms of an onset (1, 2, 3, 9); chance level ~4.6 of 10 at 3.87 onsets/s, so the seam starts do not sit on the bed's hits more than chance. Settle frames hit on 4, 5, 6 (18 / -25 / +5 ms). 4 is a +63 ms near miss, 6 a +88 ms near miss.
